extensions_confirm_default_body: Affects only future notifications and launch entry points; this window stays open.
extensions_confirm_disable_body: Stops the background services this package provides. Linked accounts may go offline for a while.
extensions_confirm_disable_independent_b: This package runs independently, so only the intent to disable it is recorded. Processes started some other way keep running.
extensions_confirm_enable_body: Once enabled, the background service may start this package's services.
extensions_confirm_enable_independent_bo: This package runs independently, so only the intent to enable it is recorded. No process starts automatically.
extensions_confirm_profiles_unknown: Linked accounts couldn't be read, so the impact isn't known yet.
extensions_confirm_remove_body: The package will be removed; accounts and local mail are kept. Its services stop working until you reinstall it.
extensions_error_profiles_unavailable: Extensions loaded, but linked accounts couldn't be read. Check which accounts depend on an extension before changing it.
extensions_host_frontend_info_denied: This frontend isn't allowed to read the frontend manifest.
extensions_host_frontend_info_failed: Can't read the frontend manifest right now.
extensions_host_subscribe_failed: Couldn't subscribe to the background connection status.
extensions_install_from_folder: Install / upgrade from a local folder
extensions_install_note: Choose the complete folder that contains plugin.toml or frontend.toml. It is verified and its permissions are shown before installing; upgrades use the same entry point.
extensions_intro: Extend when you need to; focus on mail the rest of the time.
extensions_modules_note: This lists the interface modules in this window. Mail services and other frontends are managed separately above.
extensions_permission_frontend_open: Receive navigation intents and read frontend manifests
extensions_permission_mailbox_write: Change mail and the sync queue
extensions_plugins_empty: No service extensions installed. Regular IMAP / SMTP accounts don't need one.
extensions_preview_warning: This is an executable package that runs on this computer. Install it only from sources you trust. The permissions above limit the mail API; they are not an operating system sandbox.
extensions_provider_open_requested: Asked the provider extension to open its own management window.
extensions_registry_command_location: Command needs at least one location: {id}
extensions_registry_contribution_namespa: Contribution is outside its module namespace: {id}
extensions_registry_role_provider: Role must have exactly one provider: {role}
extensions_registry_role_required: Can't remove the only provider of a required role: {role}
extensions_rollback_note: The current version and the rollback version swap places. Roll back again to return to this version.
extensions_rolled_back: Switched to the confirmed rollback version.
